summary.en: Organon's accessible disclosures emphasize marketed women's-health products and partner-supplied biosimilars, with a thin verified investigational pipeline after program closures. Sun Pharma's agreed acquisition remains a key corporate event.
summary.zh: Organon 可获取的披露内容侧重于已上市的女性健康产品和合作伙伴供应的生物类似药,在项目终止后,经核实的在研管线较为单薄。Sun Pharma 已达成的收购仍是关键的公司事件。

watch.en: Sun Pharma agreed to acquire Organon for USD 14 per share in cash; the September filing still describes the transaction as pending.
watch.zh: Sun Pharma 同意以每股 USD 14 现金收购 Organon;9 月的申报文件仍将该交易描述为待完成。

watch.en: Organon discontinued OG-6219 and OG-7191 clinical programs in 2025.
watch.zh: Organon 于 2025 年终止了 OG-6219 和 OG-7191 临床项目。

watch.en: A July 2026 Samsung Bioepis agreement added an unnamed Australian biosimilar; Samsung retains development and manufacturing responsibility.
watch.zh: 2026 年 7 月与 Samsung Bioepis 达成的协议新增了一款未具名的澳大利亚生物类似药;Samsung 保留开发和生产责任。

watch.en: Nexplanon, fertility products and biosimilar commercialization drive the disclosed operating portfolio.
watch.zh: Nexplanon、生育产品和生物类似药商业化构成已披露的在营产品组合。
